def transform(grid):
    """Decode the repeated marker lattice to the compact color matrix."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Marker positions are at regular row/column intervals; 9 marks empty slots.
    rows = range(7, h, 3)
    cols = range(3, w, 4)
    lattice = [[1 if grid[r][c] == 9 else grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    # A cell gets the color shared by its four corner markers; otherwise background 1.
    return [
        [lattice[i][j]
         if lattice[i][j] == lattice[i + 1][j] == lattice[i][j + 1] == lattice[i + 1][j + 1]
         else 1
         for j in range(len(lattice[0]) - 1)]
        for i in range(len(lattice) - 1)
    ]

def transform(grid):
    """Decode the marked rectangle boundaries as a cell pattern."""
    # The outermost nonuniform boundary tiles are the source pattern.
    # The repeated edge decoration encodes a solid panel of the dominant color.
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[bg for _ in range(w // 2)] for _ in range(h // 2)]
